mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 3.8% signals labor market deterioration and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.8.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) combined with stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 5.0%) indicates inadequate inflation response, triggering equity valuation contraction and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually signals supply constraints that increase input costs and reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO annualized growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST > 1400) reflect robust consumer demand and economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job gains exceeding 250,000 signal labor market overheating that may trigger inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) indicates demand-pull inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) creates recession fears that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5.
